answer: A newcomer must climb, not just sign up. It first camps on a public mesa by locking a bond equal to three epochs of median emission and posting its funding-parent fingerprint. On a probation terrace it may produce work but cannot vote, attest, or collect emission, and it may take at most one sponsor per epoch, with sponsors' first-seen epochs at least eight apart. After three clean epochs with no parent collision, a lotus of suffrage is issued and the bond becomes slash insurance. If two keys later share a parent UTXO, both bonds are slashed and the lotus is burned.
